tickets.title: Core spatial math: 3D vectors and WorldCoord directional stepping
tickets.description: Implement 3D vector arithmetic (Vector3) and block coordinate spatial navigation (WorldCoord). Includes vector transformations, cross/dot products, normalization, orientation-based coordinate steps (0..5: -Y, +Y, -Z, +Z, -X, +X), indirect corner stepping (indStep), and square distance calculations. Done: unit tests pass for Vector3 operations and WorldCoord directional stepping matching original RedPowerCore behavior.

tickets.title: Model loader, TagFile serialization and texture vertex primitives
tickets.description: Implement RedPower custom TagFile format parser/writer and 3D sub-voxel model reader (RenderModel). Parses stream tokens, nested tags, comments, vertex lists, UV coordinate maps, and model grouping hierarchies. Done: unit tests successfully parse TagFile structures and load sub-voxel mesh definitions from RenderModel data.

tickets.title: Sub-voxel multipart tile entity and coverable block infrastructure
tickets.description: Implement compound sub-voxel multipart tile infrastructure (TileExtended, TileMultipart, TileCoverable, TileCovered). Tracks up to 29 sub-voxel components (6 face covers, 12 edge strips, 8 corner pieces, 3 structural column axes) per block space using bitmasks and occupancy arrays. Enforces occlusion rules, part bounding boxes, harvest drop calculations, NBT persistence, and frame movement packet serialization. Done: unit tests pass for multi-part placement, collision bounding boxes, face occlusion masking, and NBT roundtrip.

tickets.title: Red alloy and bundled wire network BFS pathfinder
tickets.description: Implement wire graph traversal and flood-fill pathfinding (WirePathfinder). Resolves wire connectivity across surface faces, planar 90-degree corners, wrapped edge corners, and jacketed cable conduits. Propagates signal search fronts across connected wire clusters. Done: unit tests verify connected component pathfinding over complex corner transitions and jacketed columns matching RedPower wiring rules.

tickets.title: Pneumatic tube Dijkstra shortest-path router and FIFO buffer
tickets.description: Implement pneumatic tube network topology detection, Dijkstra shortest-path route finding (TubeLib, RouteFinder), and machine item FIFO buffering (TubeBuffer). Computes tube connections with cover occlusion, color compatibility filtering (16 dye colors), path cost calculation (+2 per hop, +1 per turn penalty, +1,000,000 for Restrictor Tubes), and zero-drop backpressure handling. Done: unit tests pass for route discovery, turn penalties, restrictor tube routing priorities, and TubeBuffer FIFO NBT serialization.

tickets.title: Pneumatic tube in-flight item simulation and flow dynamics
tickets.description: Implement in-flight pneumatic tube item simulation (TubeItem, TubeFlow). Advances item progress through tube sections (standard 3.0 blocks/sec, magtube 16.0 blocks/tick), handles junction route transitions, color tag preservation, blockage bounce-back into origin buffers, and full NBT persistence. Done: unit tests verify item movement tick advancement, arrival scheduling, bounce handling on closed endpoints, and NBT roundtrip.

tickets.title: Sub-voxel rendering context, microblock mesh generation and highlight preview
tickets.description: Implement sub-voxel mesh rendering context (RenderContext), microblock cover rendering (RenderCovers), raycast selection box rendering, and placement preview highlights (RenderHighlight). Computes matrix rotations, face UV alignments, smooth lighting interpolation, and pointer rendering for analog dials. Done: rendering unit tests and mesh generation tests verify exact sub-voxel vertices and UV coordinates matching original RedPower box dimensions.

tickets.title: RedPowerCore lifecycle registration, subsystem init hooks and crafting callbacks
tickets.description: Implement RedPowerCore lifecycle registration, subsystem initialization hooks, and crafting/smelting callbacks in native mixins. Binds native hooks for block entity tick loops, block entity descriptions, and crafting callbacks. Done: mixin compilation clean and native hooks initialize core subsystems on mod load.

tickets.title: RedPowerCore network packet dispatch, terminal sync and GUI event routing
tickets.description: Implement network packet dispatch, terminal synchronization, and GUI event routing in native mixins. Handles client/server packet routing for mod network channels and screen opening/interaction. Done: mixin compilation clean and network/GUI dispatch routines handle core packets correctly.
